title: cookie
description: Per-user state for the cookie minigame.

gifted.description: Total cookies the user has gifted to others

beenGifted.description: Total cookies others have gifted to this user

sloted.description: Lifetime cookies wagered/spent on the slot machine

claimedToday.description: Whether the daily !cookie has been claimed (reset daily)

giftedToday.description: Whether the user has used their daily gift (reset daily)

usedSlot.description: Whether the daily !slot has been used (reset daily)

stolenToday.description: Whether the user has stolen today (reset daily)

gotStolen.description: Cookies stolen from this user in the current period

gotStolenBy.description: Login of the most recent thief, null otherwise

totalStolen.description: Lifetime cookies this user has stolen from others

totalGotStolen.description: Lifetime cookies stolen from this user
